resources.string: I\'m a software engineer who builds full-stack products and believes good software should feel simple. I made MHW Phone because the phone app is the one app everyone opens every day — it deserves to be fast, calm and beautiful.

• Fewer settings, better defaults. Every option you don\'t have to think about is one I\'ve already tuned for you. You only choose what truly needs your opinion — your theme, your language, your swipes.
• Fast and focused. No ads, no purchases, no tracking. Just calling, contacts and history, done well.
• Built for everyone. Arabic and English search that understands how people really type names — with or without hamza and tashkeel.
• Simple by design. I follow KISS and YAGNI: nothing is added unless it makes the app better for you today.
My goal is simple: to make MHW Phone the best phone app on the market.
